answers.workaround:
Yes, but a drop in game performance.

One solution I found was this:

```gdscript
func _can_start_anim() -> bool:
	return not paused and not finished and node_is_processing(node_to_animate)

func node_is_processing(node: Node) -> bool:
	while node:
		match node.process_mode:
			Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED:
				return false
			Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS, Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE:
				return true
			Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT:
				node = node.get_parent()
	return false
```

But make this to every Node can consume performance because there may be several of them
